question: How can even a wise person be affected at the tip of nectar by burning essence?
premises: The tip of nectar is involved
There is burning by the essence of juice
Even a wise person is affected
inference: Even a wise person may experience burning at the tip of nectar by its potent essence.
uncertainties: The physiological and yogic referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are ambiguous.
plain_english: Even a wise person may be burned at the tip of nectar by the essence of its juice.
